verses.mystical_translation: Some prayers end in darkness; their presence in scripture means darkness is still allowed to speak.
The poem enters through unrelieved lament, death, sheol, allowing what is real to be named before it is transformed.

safety_note: This psalm preserves profound despair without blaming the sufferer. It must not romanticize self-harm or be used to shame depression or require forced optimism.
